title: Presidents not told unless, like Bush 41, they were CIA director

tellings.quote: So unless you're George H.W. Bush, Bush 41, who is director of the CIA as the president of the United States, you probably don't even know

plain: Most American presidents are never told about the government's secret UFO work, the claim goes, unless they once ran the CIA, as George H. W. Bush did before he became the 41st president. A former US intelligence officer named David Grusch says this to Jesse Michels in a 2023 interview: unless you are "Bush 41", he says, "you probably don't even know." If true, it would mean the programs are hidden even from the people who are supposed to command them.
